title: Add independent KOKKOS differential execution adapter
problem: A Kokkos installation can select a different DefaultExecutionSpace from the route requested by a test, producing a misleading backend result.
example:
--route kokkos-cuda requires DefaultExecutionSpace::name() == "Cuda".
A Serial installation returns 77 before formatting, rather than being reported
as a successful CUDA comparison.
design: Wrap the existing base compiler adapter with Kokkos includes/link flags, require the requested execution space, run one parallel_for, and fence before finalization. Advertise an accelerator wrapper only when its base adapter is present.
tradeoffs: Kokkos must be installed externally with the requested execution space. Source-generation tests cover the guard, launch and lifecycle, while runtime/device availability remains unqualified here.
docs: Only advertise kokkos-cuda when the CUDA base adapter is present. Kokkos must be installed externally with the selected execution space; no site profiles are included.
